assets.name: xoltacan-drawer
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Painted fantasy RPG encyclopedia illustration, rich atmospheric brushwork, exquisite aged materials, no text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no people. Decorative atmosphere rather than canonical geography. Asset: portrait 9:16 background for a narrow navigation drawer for Xoltacan, a lush jungle island. Immense ancient tropical tree with sculptural buttress roots, curling lianas and emerald ferns along edges, a tiny mossy carved stone relic nestled at bottom. Deep jade mist and dark green canopy. Quiet dark green central vertical space for overlaid navigation, luminous delicate leaf edges, painterly jungle adventure mood. Ground level intimate composition, no aerial island or coast. Full bleed vertical artwork.
